accordions.title: Easy to develop
accordions.description: Going from use case to delivered integration should be a matter of `npm install` and minutes of time. We won't stop iterating on Frigg until it is that dead simple.

accordions.title: Inexpensive
accordions.description: Frigg's serverless architecture, coupled with hosting on your own cloud service provider accounts, means that you pay next to nothing until users start leveraging your integration. Once they do, you only pay for compute power and data storage. Simple.

accordions.title: Modular and Extensible
accordions.description: Frigg is intentionally built to foster an open ecosystem of plugins, modules, and extensions. From simple modules like our field-level encryption middleware, to complex modules like our "Sync" Manager, Frigg's library of modules will only keep growing from here. We're excited by what the community is going to come up with!

accordions.title: Scalable
accordions.description: Your integrations should function the same for the smallest use case to the biggest whales in your customer base, and you shouldn't have to worry about toggling the infrastructure to match. Frigg is built on serverless technologies and architected to reduce this overhead. It will just work, whether you're syncing three records daily, or millions of records every hour.
